# Skyrun AutoSupply

> Warehouse and inventory management for Skyrun auto parts. Staff and administrators record stock in and stock out, follow each item's stock card, track sales and profit, manage suppliers, and locate items on the warehouse map. Sign-in is required.

## Main sections

- [Dashboard](/): stock value, low stock, reorder plan and recent activity
- [Inventory](/): the item list, with item details and pictures
- [Stock](/): stock in and stock out sheets, grouped by invoice number
- [Stock card](/): the full history of one item
- [Stock in history](/): stock-in invoices, with edit, undo and delete
- [Sales](/): sales and profit reports and sales history
- [Supplier](/): suppliers and the items they supply
- [Warehouse map](/): floors, aisles and racks
